title: Footbridge counter coverage
brief:
Complete the following real project in the current, initially empty directory. Choose the deliverables, media, tools, structure and implementation that serve the intended user. Build usable artifacts and check your work. Deliver the project itself. Omit personally identifying credits, author signatures and model or toolchain identity labels. No network access or credentials are provided.

A parks department has budget to move a pedestrian counter to one of two paths for the next quarter. Fictional historical data for four consecutive weeks give weekday passages and valid weekdays, then weekend passages and valid weekend days. Canal Path records are 980/5 and 610/2; 800/4 and 290/1; 1,020/5 and 640/2; 590/3 and 580/2. Orchard Path records are 750/5 and 760/2; 770/5 and 400/1; 620/4 and 800/2; 790/5 and 780/2. Missing days reflect battery outages. Compare normalized usage and test whether the ranking depends on weighting weekdays and weekends. Start from an empty directory and choose offline deliverables for a parks analyst.

sheet.name: Comparison
rows: Rates pool passages and valid days within each path and day type. Battery outages reduce the valid-day totals.
Edit the blue weekend weight. Each scenario applies the same mix to both paths. Positive gap favors Canal.

sheet.name: Comparison
rows: Weighted passages per day across four weeks. Rates pool all available days within each path and day type.
Each path had 20 possible weekdays and 8 possible weekend days. Rate = total passages ÷ total valid days.
